name: plugin
summary: Build the JUCE 8 plugin (VST3/AU/Standalone, WebView editor embedding web/dist), run pluginval (strictness 5), and load the built VST3 headlessly like a DAW: golden fixtures must hash exactly like the native engine and the editor must build the stage from the patch. `package` makes the notarised universal macOS installer (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg).
